name: D2: Text Filter
description: Submodule of D2: Declarative Diagramming. Adds a text-format filter plugin (id filter_d2) that replaces [d2]...[/d2] blocks in content with an SVG diagram rendered by the parent module's D2Helper. Enable it and add the 'D2 Filter' to a text format to let editors embed inline diagrams.
project_description: A submodule of the D2: Declarative Diagramming project. It provides a text-format filter that allows embedding D2 diagrams in content. Enable the d2_filter submodule and configure a text format to use the 'D2 Filter'; editors can then write [d2]...[/d2] blocks whose contents are rendered to an inline SVG.
